svg.aria-label: A sale with payment splits, drawn as stars: one USDC payment enters the item's ownerless split address, distribute() sends it on as streams whose width shows each share, to the seller and to the contributors by record weight; WITAN's fee is a faint line at 0% on testnet; no WITAN wallet is in the path
svg.font-family: 'Wanted Sans Variable', 'Wanted Sans', 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: No WITAN wallet in the path
